subject: organic
question: 有机化学·自由基极性：根据 Radical Learn 所采用的常见反应性分类，2-Methylprop-1-enyl radical 通常主要表现为亲核型还是亲电型自由基？（回答该教材中的主要倾向，具体反应条件可能影响表现。）
explanation_en: Vinyl radicals are σ radicals with more s character than alkyl radicals: they are electrophilic and usually add to electron-rich or plain alkenes, which is why vinyl radical cyclisations onto unactivated alkenes work.
